newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mercedes Spanish production still stopped.
newsitem.headline: Mercedes Spanish production still stopped.

text.p: German carmaker Mercedes-Benz AG said on Wednesday that the ongoing truckers' strike in Spain had so far prevented production of about 1,000 vehicles at its plants in Spain.
A Mercedes spokesman at the group's headquarters in Stuttgart said production was stopped on Wednesday at factories in the Spanish cities of Barcelona and Vitoria.
He would not predict when production would be resumed.
Mercedes builds the "Vito" transporter and a luxury version of the vehicle called the "V-Class". The Barcelona factory produces parts for production of the vehicle.

But Mercedes said the Spanish strike has not yet affected its domestic production, saying it only bought a small amount of parts from Spanish suppliers and ones that can be obtained from other suppliers.
